lines.en: The secretary told me that Mr. Harmsworth would see me.
lines.zh: 秘书告诉我哈姆斯沃思先生会见我。

lines.en: I felt very nervous when I went into his office.
lines.zh: 当我走进他的办公室时，我感到非常紧张。

lines.en: He did not look up from his desk when I entered.
lines.zh: 我进去时，他没有从办公桌上抬起头。

lines.en: he said that business was very bad.
He told me that the firm could not afford to pay such large salaries.
lines.zh: 他告诉我公司负担不起支付如此高的薪水。

lines.en: I knew that my turn had come.
'Mr. Harmsworth,' I said in a weak voice.
lines.zh: “哈姆斯沃思先生，”我用微弱的声音说。

lines.en: Then he smiled and told me I would receive an extra thousand pounds a year!
lines.zh: 然后他笑了，告诉我每年将额外获得一千英镑！
